## CacheExternal.refreshLruCache() method

Refreshes the LRU cache by re-accessing keys in order.

**Signature:**

```typescript
refreshLruCache(maxLength?: number): void;
```

## Parameters

<tbody><tr><td>

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Maximum number of keys to refresh. If omitted, refreshes all keys.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

This method iterates through the store keys and calls `get()` on each to refresh the LRU order. Only applicable for memory-based stores using `Map`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const cache = new CacheExternal("memory", 60000, "app");

// Refresh all keys
cache.refreshLruCache();

// Refresh only the first 100 keys
cache.refreshLruCache(100);
```
